knowledgeObjects.name: Purpose & Introduction
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Establish the website's role as the customer-facing layer of a wider operating system, and the six practical questions that expanded it into a platform problem
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part II Ch.6 (Purpose, Introduction)
governanceRules: The website is not an isolated visual asset. It is the customer-facing layer of a wider operating system connecting brand, products, orders, content, communication, and company control
validationRules: All six questions and both realities preserved

knowledgeObjects.name: Founder Perspective
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Preserve the Founder Note governing the domain's communication-complexity standard
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part II Ch.6 (Founder Perspective)
governanceRules: Explain the work in very easy language, step by step
A sophisticated system that cannot be understood, reviewed, or resumed by its owner is not operationally strong
validationRules: The Founder Note preserved verbatim, never softened

knowledgeObjects.name: The Digital Operating Stack
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Preserve the eight-layer digital operating stack and its non-rewrite rule
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part II Ch.6 (The Digital Operating Stack)
governanceRules: No layer should silently rewrite another. The website must use approved brand and product knowledge; it cannot invent them
validationRules: Figure 1.1's flow and all eight table rows preserved; the rule never dropped

knowledgeObjects.name: Foundation Principles
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Preserve the five foundation principles governing platform design discipline
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part II Ch.6 (Foundation Principles)
governanceRules: A button, form, login option, or order status must not imply a functioning capability unless the supporting workflow exists
Content must be manageable, but editing freedom cannot permit accidental changes to protected brand assets, product facts, or approved language
validationRules: All five principles preserved with their exact governing statements

knowledgeObjects.name: Operating Boundaries
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Preserve the ownership-boundary table distinguishing this Part's scope from content owned elsewhere, and the WARNING against digital-team overreach
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part II Ch.6 (Operating Boundaries)
governanceRules: A digital team may implement approved knowledge, but it may not redefine the brand, product, or Founder philosophy through interface copy or technical convenience
validationRules: All five ownership rows preserved; the WARNING never softened

knowledgeObjects.name: Implementation Sequence
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part II Ch.6 (Implementation Sequence)
validationRules: All eight steps preserved in exact order

knowledgeObjects.name: Chapter Governance Summary
knowledgeObjects.purpose: Preserve the chapter's closing governance content
knowledgeObjects.scope: Common Mistakes, Best Practices, Action Checklist, Chapter Summary
inputs: MUV Knowledge Library Part II Ch.6 closing subsections
validationRules: 6 checklist items in original order; no Key Takeaways section invented
